packageRules.description: Hold the Solid 2 major: solid-js 2 dropped the ./web export in favour of @solidjs/web, @solidjs/router 2 requires solid-js ^2, and the build plugin capable of v2 is still prerelease (vite-plugin-solid 3.0.0-next). solid-chartjs has no 2.x release (peer solid-js ^1.7.5, last publish 2024-07). Revisit when solid-chartjs and vite-plugin-solid ship stable v2 support.
